description:
Audit all 8 existing teams' team.json and TEAM.md files to determine exactly what structured data should move from freeform markdown to the JSON schema, and what should remain as narrative. Design the v2 schema adding these new fields:

**`objectives`** (array of strings) — Current period goals for the team. Examples: "Achieve 80% portfolio completion on active initiatives", "Publish 2+ dev log threads per week". Updated by director-swarm decisions or human input. These give heartbeat agents clear targets beyond freeform TEAM.md instructions.

**`kpis`** (array of {name, target}) — Measurable success indicators. Examples: {name: "agent_success_rate", target: ">90%"}, {name: "content_published_per_week", target: ">=2"}. Related to objectives but more granular. The meta-optimization team and project wiki can track these over time.

**`consumers`** (array of team IDs) — Who depends on this team's outputs. Example: revenue-research's consumers are ["director-swarm"] because the director consumes opportunity briefs for portfolio decisions. This is manually maintained because consumer relationships aren't derivable from code.

**`contributions`** (array of {type, section, description}) — What the team produces that's institutionally significant and wiki-worthy. The `type` is a semantic label (e.g., "campaign-launched", "root-cause-analysis"). The `section` maps to a wiki section path (e.g., "marketing/campaigns", "quality/lessons-learned"). The `description` explains what this contribution type means. This is the key integration point with the project-wiki scenario — the wiki maintenance agent reads these to know what events to scan for in each team's handoffs, decisions, and knowledge entries.

The research should also:
- Determine whether `dependencies` should be a computed view (derived from HEARTBEAT.md skill references, CLI tool usage, acceptance_allow paths) rather than a stored field, and if so, specify the computation logic
- For each of the 8 teams, draft the actual values for objectives, kpis, consumers, and contributions based on their TEAM.md, HEARTBEAT.md, and RESPONSIBILITIES.md files
- Define the migration path from schemaVersion 1 to 2 (backward compatibility considerations)
- Specify what content should be removed from TEAM.md after migration (anything that's now a structured field) vs. what stays (charter nuances, operating procedures, decision processes, skill references — inherently freeform "how we work" content)

Current team.json fields: kind, schemaVersion, id, displayName, mission, enabled, spawnMode, decisionMode, shared, revision, createdAt, updatedAt. The prompt builder in scenarios/prompt-manager/api/heartbeat/prompt_builder.go currently reads team.json for SpawnMode and DecisionMode only — it gets the rich context from TEAM.md as freeform markdown.

Teams to audit: director-swarm (enabled), marketing-crew, revenue-research, meta-optimization, scenario-feature, scenario-qa, scenario-debug, scenario-refactor (all disabled). All team files are under scenarios/prompt-manager/store/teams/.
name: team-schema-v2-design
title: Design Team Schema v2 With Organizational Properties
